SELECT t.accommodation_id,t.accommodation_name,SUM(t.gross),SUM(t.refund),SUM(t.gross)-SUM(t.refund) FROM (SELECT a.id accommodation_id,a.name accommodation_name,COALESCE(pt.amount,0) gross,0 refund FROM payment_transaction pt JOIN reservation r ON r.id=pt.reservation_id JOIN accommodation a ON a.id=r.accommodation_id WHERE a.member_id=6675 AND pt.transaction_type='CONFIRM' AND DATE(pt.created_at) BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31' UNION ALL SELECT a.id,a.name,0,COALESCE(pt.cancel_amount,0) FROM payment_transaction pt JOIN reservation r ON r.id=pt.reservation_id JOIN accommodation a ON a.id=r.accommodation_id WHERE a.member_id=6675 AND pt.transaction_type IN ('CANCEL','PARTIAL_CANCEL') AND DATE(COALESCE(pt.canceled_at,pt.created_at)) BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31') t GROUP BY t.accommodation_id,t.accommodation_name ORDER BY t.accommodation_id
note: settlement endpoint includes ledger joins; reservation/payment APIs themselves excluded
